title: Worker process crashes after bazel clean

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
/CC @hanwen @damienmg 

I'm using Bazel 0.4.5. To reproduce, use Gitiles project: [1].

The sequence `bazel build gitiles; bazel clean; bazel build gitiles` consistently leads to worker process crash:

```
$ bazel build gitiles
.
INFO: Found 1 target...
Target //:gitiles up-to-date:
  bazel-bin/gitiles.war
INFO: Elapsed time: 8.867s, Critical Path: 5.87s

$ bazel clean --async 
INFO: Starting clean.
INFO: Output tree moved to /home/davido/.cache/bazel/_bazel_davido/9fdffb7f2a398de2e1a63eaee2ea7c50/execroot/gitiles_tmp_18801 for deletion

$ bazel build gitiles
INFO: Found 1 target...
ERROR: /home/davido/projects/gitiles/blame-cache/BUILD:8:1: Java compilation in rule '//blame-cache:lib' failed: Worker process sent response with exit code: 1.
java.io.IOException: Cannot write dependencies to bazel-out/local-fastbuild/bin/blame-cache/liblib.jdeps
	at com.google.devtools.build.buildjar.javac.plugins.dependency.DependencyModule.emitDependencyInformation(DependencyModule.java:137)
	at com.google.devtools.build.buildjar.SimpleJavaLibraryBuilder.run(SimpleJavaLibraryBuilder.java:188)
	at com.google.devtools.build.buildjar.BazelJavaBuilder.processRequest(BazelJavaBuilder.java:90)
	at com.google.devtools.build.buildjar.BazelJavaBuilder.runPersistentWorker(BazelJavaBuilder.java:67)
	at com.google.devtools.build.buildjar.BazelJavaBuilder.main(BazelJavaBuilder.java:44)
Caused by: java.io.FileNotFoundException: bazel-out/local-fastbuild/bin/blame-cache/liblib.jdeps (No such file or directory)
	at java.io.FileOutputStream.open0(Native Method)
	at java.io.FileOutputStream.open(FileOutputStream.java:270)
	at java.io.FileOutputStream.<init>(FileOutputStream.java:213)
	at java.io.FileOutputStream.<init>(FileOutputStream.java:101)
	at com.google.devtools.build.buildjar.javac.plugins.dependency.DependencyModule.emitDependencyInformation(DependencyModule.java:133)
	... 4 more
Target //:gitiles failed to build
Use --verbose_failures to see the command lines of failed build steps.
INFO: Elapsed time: 2.914s, Critical Path: 1.06s
```

Workaround: killing the worker process with `bazel shutdown` fixes the problem:

```
$ bazel shutdown

$ bazel build gitiles
.
INFO: Found 1 target...
Target //:gitiles up-to-date:
  bazel-bin/gitiles.war
INFO: Elapsed time: 8.641s, Critical Path: 5.41s
```

* [1] git clone https://gerrit.googlesource.com/gitiles
